handback.title: A label run also does a dropped close's work
handback.summary: Adding the autopilot label by hand no longer loses the work of a close it pushed out of the queue.
handback.user_story: When a label replaces a waiting close run, the close's autopilot work still happens.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a label run follows a dropped close, a parent whose last sub-issue closed closes, saying its tree is done.
acceptance_criteria.words: a waiting close run it replaces loses its close work

edge_cases.case: The parent still has an open sub-issue, so it stays open with no comment.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a label run follows a dropped close, every issue of a done tree goes off autopilot.
acceptance_criteria.words: a waiting close run it replaces loses its close work

edge_cases.case: Trees still open, and the issue just labeled, stay on autopilot.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a label run follows a dropped close that unblocks an issue planned while blocked, its planner starts once.
acceptance_criteria.words: a waiting close run it replaces loses its close work

edge_cases.case: Another blocker is still open, so nothing starts.
